All done. Summary of this session's work (P9 — navigation, header balance, lesson entry point, centralized copy):

1. **Navigation** — added Studio/Krediti to `app-sidebar.tsx` (expanded desktop/mobile nav + collapsed rail); left the 4-slot mobile bottom bar untouched per its own "do not add a fifth entry" comment.
2. **Header balance pill** — new `CreditsBalancePill` in the sidebar, visible on every `/app` page (mobile top bar + expanded desktop top), `rounded-full`, amber when balance is 0, realtime via `useQuery` (no polling).
3. **Lesson → Studio bridge** — "Otvori u Studiju" button in `course-lab.tsx`'s output column (shown when `outputKind !== "text"`), linking to `/app/studio?lessonId=&taskId=`; `studio-page.tsx` now reads those params and forwards them into `createJob`, completing the labOutputs → taskProgress → leaderboard chain from STUDIO-PLAN 1.1.
4. **Centralized messages** — new `lib/studio-messages.ts` consolidating `createJob`/`deleteJob` error messages and all Studio empty states (paused, not enrolled, no generations, no credits, no packs, no history, gallery empty/no-matches), each with a human sentence + next step; wired into `studio-page.tsx`, `credits-page.tsx`, `studio-gallery-page.tsx`. Added 3 newly-reachable error codes (`ZADATAK_BEZ_LEKCIJE`, `ZADATAK_NIJE_U_LEKCIJI`, `NEISPRAVNO_TRAJANJE`).

All four verification gates are clean: `convex codegen`, `lint` (0 errors), `build`, and `test` (387/388 — the one failure is the pre-existing flaky `chat.test.ts` timeout already documented in P8, confirmed unrelated and passing in isolation). Full details, decisions, and manual-check notes are appended to `docs/STUDIO-PROGRESS.md` under **P9**.
